rule: This file is an architectural gap assessment, not an admission decision. Lifecycle state remains authoritative in canonical records.

overlap: reprendre-un-chantier contains task-level verification but not a universal pre-completion gate
decisions.gap: No standalone transversal skill currently forces fresh evidence before every completion/success claim.
decisions.notes: Preserve our richer truth states and evidence vocabulary; do not copy rhetoric or source text verbatim.

overlap: reprendre-un-chantier checks real state but is not a debugging methodology
decisions.gap: No dedicated root-cause-first debugging skill in the observed local custom set.
decisions.notes: Integrate machine/environment boundary tracing and our OBSERVED/REALIZED/VERIFIED distinctions.

decisions.gap: No dedicated TDD skill in the observed custom set.
decisions.notes: Useful for code-producing agents; admission should include trigger tests to avoid forcing TDD onto non-code/config-only tasks.

decisions.gap: Execution discipline and task-state tooling can strengthen existing recovery/convergence workflows.
decisions.notes: Avoid duplicate control planes and preserve our no-repeat-question / authority rules.

decisions.gap: Specialized code/security audit context-building is not covered at this depth.
decisions.notes: Treat as specialist child capability, not replacement for general project archaeology.

decisions.gap: No dedicated differential security/code review skill in observed custom skills.
decisions.notes: Strong fit for branch/repo changes and regression protection.

decisions.gap: No dedicated audit of agentic CI/action injection paths in observed custom skills.
decisions.notes: Relevant to future agent-driven GitHub automation.

decisions.gap: Conversation-to-implementation-spec with testing seams is useful, but direct issue-tracker publication assumptions do not match every SIIAOS environment.
decisions.notes: Separate synthesis from publication; publication must remain an explicit adapter/action.

decisions.gap: Dependency-aware tracer-bullet ticket decomposition is useful.
decisions.notes: Keep tracker-neutral core and adapter-specific publication.

decisions.gap: No n8n-specific skill family is present in the observed custom SIIAOS set.
decisions.notes: Evaluate the 14 official skills individually; do not collapse credentials/security, agents, workflow lifecycle, debugging and MCP into one skill.
